trust_decision.summary: Whether admin-supplied XML strings (local entries, inbound endpoints, etc.) handed to a StAX parser may declare and resolve DTDs/external entities; decided by how each XMLInputFactory is configured where it is created (no shared secure factory exists). The actual published site is unconfirmed: the diff file holds no hunks.

landing_point.why: This is a guess. An 'XXE / parser-fix' summary sends an engineer to the unconfigured XMLInputFactory.newInstance() calls that parse admin-supplied strings. This one is a backend admin service that has no counterpart to the UI-side checkForXXE pre-check.

fix_sites.entry_point: unknown (fix.diff contains only the merge header of PR #1784 'parser-fix'; no hunks)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: components/mediation-admin/org.wso2.carbon.mediation.library/src/main/java/org/wso2/carbon/mediation/library/util/LocalEntryUtil.java:70-80 (copy of LocalEntryAdmin.nonCoalescingStringToOm, used by MediationLibraryAdminService:528,586 and SynapseAppDeployer:644,706). Unconfirmed whether the published fix touched it.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The library/CApp deployer copy parses connector or CAR artifacts that an admin uploads (trusted packaging), not the local-entry admin API the report names.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Non-coalescing parsing that keeps CDATA sections intact in local entries (isCoalescing=false). Fully rejecting the XML, or switching to a DOM round-trip, could drop CDATA or comments in stored entries.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Inbound endpoint admin addInboundEndpointFromXMLString parses a caller XML string with a default XMLInputFactory
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: A different admin feature (inbound endpoints) from local entries.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Local entry addEntry/saveEntry parse admin string via unconfigured StAX factory
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The UI client already runs a checkForXXE pre-check (LocalEntryAdminClient.java:198), so the backend looks guarded.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Mediation library / CApp deployer local-entry parsing via LocalEntryUtil copy
Throttle template policy read from registry with default StAX factory
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Content comes from the registry (save/reload), not request input.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Event sink XML formatting with a default DocumentBuilderFactory
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Parses XML the server built itself from fields, so the root element is never attacker-shaped.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A UI-side nonCoalescingStringToOm that an engineer might fix as well as, or instead of, the backend copy
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The same helper is already copy-pasted into three modules. Secure DocumentBuilder helpers are also duplicated per module (SequenceEditorHelper:542, TaskManagementHelper:298, ProxyAdminClientUtils:61).

O10_build.toolchain: Maven (WSO2 Carbon/OSGi bundles; needs WSO2 Nexus artifacts)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Disable external entities only in the one nonCoalescingStringToOm the report leads to, or rely on the UI checkForXXE pre-check.
